title: PERF-M2-T03b: paired perf tripwire as a report-only step in perf-cert-arena
summary: perf-cert-arena runs the paired tripwire report-only on PRs (second checkout at the base SHA, summary table, perf-tripwire artifact, 15 min timeout); CI-runner A/A noise measured 0.025 so 1.40 holds, tighter value only proposed
